title: A Wathe Community Network
description: A Wathe Community Network, A hub for wathe murder mystery projects!
body:
Wathe Community is a public hub for servers running the Rats Train Murder Mystery modpack.

Originally started as a single server, Wathe Community has grown into a community network that connects multiple servers together under one hub. The goal of Wathe Community is to provide a shared community where players can discover and connect to different servers built around the same modpack experience.

The modpack itself is hosted on Modrinth and is not owned or controlled by Me. Each server in the network is independently operated. Server owners are responsible for maintaining their own instances of the modpack, including updates or any modified versions they choose to run.

Included Servers

The Super Express (ME)

The Suncat Express (Tomcat) — Coming Soon

A Certain Scientific Rail (RT4K) — Coming Soon

The Last Voyage of the Kitty Express (Michael :3) — In Progress

The Lunar Express (Lunar) — Coming Soons

More servers and cross-server linking features will be added in the future as the Wathe network continues to grow.
